# Leon Tan
leon.tan@example.test | +65 6000 0012 | Singapore

## SUMMARY
Full-Stack Engineer with hands-on experience in TypeScript, React, and Node.js, delivering documented, measurable improvements for cross-functional teams. Proven ability to design frontend components and backend APIs while modeling relational data. Adept at maintaining delivery pipelines, improving application reliability, and communicating technical trade-offs to stakeholders. Committed to evidence-based decision-making and clear documentation within a collaborative environment.

## EXPERIENCE

**Full-Stack Engineer** | Example Beacon Services (Singapore)
*Jul 2023 – Present*

*   Deliver end-to-end product features using **TypeScript**, **React**, and **Node.js**, improving team turnaround by 34%.
*   Design frontend components and backend **REST APIs**; model relational data in **PostgreSQL** to support operational needs.
*   Maintain delivery pipelines and improve application reliability while managing approximately 86 work items per month with rigorous quality checks.
*   Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to present progress, risks, and technical trade-offs during fortnightly reviews.
*   Ensure all technical decisions are clearly documented for review by both technical and business teams.

**Technical Assistant** | Example Cedar Innovations (Singapore)
*Jan 2021 – Jun 2023*

*   Support recurring operational work using **REST APIs**, creating clear step-by-step documentation to ensure maintainability.
*   Investigate service requests, record findings with supporting evidence, and escalate issues effectively.
*   Develop reporting templates that reduced manual preparation time by 29%, demonstrating ability to solve ambiguous problems through data-driven approaches.

## PROJECTS

**Full-Stack Engineer Practice Project**
*   Built a demonstration project utilizing **TypeScript**, **React**, and **Node.js**.
*   Implemented testing scenarios to validate reliability and document limitations for future improvements.
*   Presented design decisions and outcomes to a peer review group, honing communication skills regarding technical trade-offs.

## EDUCATION

**Bachelor of Science in Information Systems** | Example School of Computing
*Aug 2020 – May 2024*
*   Coursework focused on software engineering, databases, cybersecurity, and applied analytics.

## SKILLS

*   **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript
*   **Frontend:** React, Next.js
*   **Backend:** Node.js, REST APIs
*   **Database:** PostgreSQL, Relational Data Modeling
*   **DevOps & Tools:** Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, AWS (Cloud Practitioner)
*   **Soft Skills:** Clear written and verbal communication, collaborative problem-solving, stakeholder management

* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
job_description:
# Full-Stack Engineer



**Company:** Example Harbour Digital (fictional)  

**Location:** Singapore  

**Employment type:** Full-time  

**Seniority:** Mid



## ABOUT THE ROLE



Example Harbour Digital is seeking a Full-Stack Engineer to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role

works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining

appropriate review, security and quality controls.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Deliver end-to-end product features.

* Design frontend components and backend apis.

* Model relational data.

* Maintain delivery pipelines.

* Improve application reliability.

* Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.

* Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* TypeScript

* React

* Node.js

* REST APIs

* PostgreSQL

* Docker

* Git

* CI/CD

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems



## PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Next.js

* AWS

* Terraform



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver

well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through

quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.
